The news discussed in this episode:

  • Report says Apple will launch a brand new "Apple Upgrade" rental program next week
  • Report says Apple will gradually phase out the iPhone Upgrade Program
  • iOS 27 code shows Apple may restrict features on leased devices after users miss payments
  • New report reveals Apple's massive Mac product roadmap
  • Leaker says the largest iPhone display ever will launch next year
